fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Inside the Spherical Mojo Cell", "body": "Dr. Moshe Daniel Block explained how the Joe cell, a set of nested pipes filled with charged water, inspired him to build a spherical version he calls the mojo cell. He argues that because water is diamagnetic and repels a magnetic field, water trapped at the center of a magnetized sphere has nowhere to go and must implode, creating a neutral center he likens to the fulcrum of a seesaw. Moshe said the cell's field speaks to the bliss body, and Topher Gardner recalled a lifted, almost blissful mood among everyone nearby when two cells resonated, an effect he says he cannot explain."}, {"title": "Buildings That Generate Their Own Energy", "body": "Topher Gardner described his work with super adobe, packing earth into long bags layered with barbed wire to raise domes and walls, including a 37 foot earth bag wall his crew built in five hours. Looking at one of his beehive domes, he realized the barbed wire runs like conductors through the earth, and he estimates a coiled 20 foot dome could hold several hundred volts of potential. Dr. Moshe Daniel Block noted that this static potential lacks the amperage to do real work, and both agreed the missing piece is converting that field into usable power."}, {"title": "The Body Follows the Mind", "body": "When the conversation turned to diet, Dr. Moshe Daniel Block said a cleaner diet supports a stronger vital body, while placing the deeper cause of illness in the mind. Chance Garton described seeing lopsided biofields in people with lopsided hips during tuning sessions, and argued that the body sits inside the mind rather than the other way around. Moshe later answered a listener's question about headaches by saying screens or food are usually triggers, while the cause tends to live in the mental and emotional field, and he encourages people to explore the belief beneath the symptom."}, {"title": "A Conscious Sun and a Hazy Sky", "body": "Chance Garton shared an idea he heard from Owen Benjamin: that the sun may be conscious and could be gently disrupting artificial technology, with chemtrails as an attempt to slow that process. Chance added his own hunch that human knowledge swings like a pendulum between inner and outer understanding. Topher Gardner called the sun a metaphysical portal and said that when he approaches the sky from the heart rather than fear, a ray tends to break through the haze. The conversation also explored the Mayan great year, the galactic center, and the letter theta."}, {"title": "Yugas, Reincarnation and Raising the Stakes", "body": "The guests weighed the Vedic yugas against their own experience. Topher Gardner favors a model where each cycle begins at its highest order and degrades, the way any building is strongest the day it is finished, so the temporal world offers no idols worth clinging to. Dr. Moshe Daniel Block framed reincarnation as the pull of unfinished desire drawing a soul back. Dylan Saccoccio said he does not see reincarnation as a punishment and sees the present as only moving forward, arguing that as a storyteller he believes every choice should carry the highest stakes rather than waiting on another life."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Tonight we are joined by Topher Gardner (BioCharisma Podcast) & Dr. Moshe Daniel to talk about their collaborative research and development of Orgone energy technology, the nature of bio-electricity, and the power of the mind to improve the flow of vital life force, within the body and in the environment.
